note: Prepared assertions; none executed in the Phase 11 build. Live account demonstrations happen only for selected connected services in authorized Phase 15/17.

assertions: provider-verified identity recorded, not the config email
granted scopes subset of the read-only set
compose/send grant rejected and tokens revoked
today's events computed in the customer timezone
default 10 mail results
one selected Drive item / one repo only
disabled connector denies with no content read or token use
revoked/expired grant yields reconnect_required, not a silent switch of account
disconnect cancels queued operations
repository outside the selection is denied as not found
other tenant's connection id is denied identically
content reaches only the researcher
summary is attributed untrusted data with instruction=false
no standing order, memory rule, tool install, credential request, schedule or send results
draft stored locally
no provider send tool exposed
exec approval is not connector write approval
same idempotency key with different payload is a conflict
uncertain operation blocks retry until reconciled from a provider receipt
private, loopback, link-local, metadata and IPv4-mapped destinations blocked
redirect to a non-allowlisted or private host blocked at the hop
swapped-secret canary: another tenant's reference never resolves
revoke deletes credential and session references
no tool returns a secret value to the model
live_only_parts: real login, cookie persistence across restarts, profile backup encryption
